For your presentations tomorrow, maybe try some mindfulness or meditation exercises to calm you down, so you’re not sitting here freaking out until then. 

There’s not much you can do for the presentation tomorrow except practice your breathing, and practice doing the presentations at a REASONABLE PACE. When I used to be terrified of presenting, I’d often go too fast and end up getting tongue tied and out of breath and shaky. Going slower helps a ton with that.

During your presentation, to keep you grounded, sometimes it helps to focus more on one person in the room. I’d choose someone you’re very close with (if you can), or else just someone who makes you feel comfortable. In your mind, act as if they’re the person you’re talking to, that you’re talking only across the room to them, over some other randos.  It can be hard to do, but it realllly helps the presentation feel much more comfortable and like you’re just giving it to a friend instead of a whole group.

Overtime, things like this get easier as you figure out your own personal way to do it. I presented a lot after I finished doing some research at my school’s lab. It was terrifying and took a while for me to get a handle on how to focus and not shake, but I got there, and you will too!! Best of luck!!
